title: Grok CLI vs Grok Build: Two Agents, One `grok`

facts.fact: The community Grok CLI project (superagent-ai/grok-cli) was created on 2025-07-14, according to the page.
facts.quote: The community project was created on 2025-07-14. xAI created theirs on 2026-07-14, exactly one year later

facts.fact: xAI's Grok Build (xai-org/grok-build) was created on 2026-07-14, according to the page.
facts.quote: xAI created theirs on 2026-07-14, exactly one year later

facts.fact: On 2026-07-20, the Grok CLI repository had 3,314 GitHub stars, according to the page's own reading of the GitHub API.
On 2026-07-20, the Grok Build repository had 20,734 GitHub stars, according to the page's own reading of the GitHub API.
The Grok CLI harness is licensed under MIT.
The Grok Build harness is licensed under Apache-2.0.
Grok CLI is published as the npm package grok-dev, while Grok Build has no npm package.
The Grok CLI linux-arm64 release asset (grok-linux-arm64) returned HTTP 404 and is not published, per the page's probe on 2026-07-20.
The Grok Build linux-aarch64 release asset (grok-0.2.106-linux-aarch64) returned HTTP 200, per the page's probe on 2026-07-20.
The Grok CLI linux-x64 release asset returned HTTP 200 on the page's 2026-07-20 probe.
The Grok CLI darwin-arm64 release asset returned HTTP 200 on the page's 2026-07-20 probe.
The Grok Build version observed by the page on 2026-07-20 was 0.2.106, with commit hash ab5ebf69ac.
The Grok CLI community project reports npm version 1.1.7 from grok --version.
facts.quote: The community CLI reports its npm version, `1.1.7`.

facts.fact: The grok-dev npm package declares engines node >=18 with no CPU restriction.
facts.quote: `grok-dev` declares `engines: node >=18` with no CPU restriction.

facts.fact: Grok CLI's installer accepts Darwin, Linux, and Windows and exits with status 1 on any other platform.
facts.quote: Grok CLI's installer accepts Darwin, Linux, and Windows and exits 1 on anything else

facts.fact: Both Grok CLI and Grok Build install a binary named grok into $HOME/.grok/bin, so they overwrite each other.
facts.quote: Both install a binary named `grok` into `$HOME/.grok/bin`, so they overwrite each other.

facts.fact: The page states that all numbers were read first-hand on 2026-07-20 using gh api, the npm registry, and HTTP probes.
facts.quote: Every number below was read first-hand on **2026-07-20** with `gh api`, the npm registry, and HTTP probes
